evidence.source_statement: Distinguish specified C++ behavior from undefined, implementation-defined and unspecified behavior when setting compatibility acceptance; document environment-specific decisions rather than asserting impossible universal parity.
source_conditions: An authorized C++-to-Rust port includes the C++-specific behavior in the agreed baseline or externally consumed interface.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relevant contexts do not narrow normative rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Inferred outcomes are descriptive and not new instructions.
interpretation.effective_rules: Source rules apply only after deliberate independent selection.
